primary_estimand: Within-checkpoint adapter-enabled minus adapter-disabled accuracy, computed per suite and macro-averaged with ARC, HellaSwag, MMLU, and GSM8K weighted equally.
primary_hypotheses: Qwen general accuracy change is positive.
Mistral general accuracy change is negative.
OLMo general accuracy change is positive.
Granite 3.3 is a two-sided neutral replication control.

analysis_plan.pairing: Pair by lm-eval task and doc_id. Abort analysis for nonidentical sample hashes.
analysis_plan.confidence_intervals: 20,000 paired bootstrap resamples within task; average tasks equally within suite and suites equally within checkpoint.
analysis_plan.tests: Exact two-sided McNemar tests per checkpoint. Holm correction across the four checkpoint tests at family-wise alpha 0.05.
analysis_plan.success: A directional exploratory effect replicates only if its Holm-adjusted two-sided test rejects zero and the effect sign matches the preregistered direction.
analysis_plan.aggregate: Report all task, suite, checkpoint, and four-checkpoint macro effects regardless of significance.

controls.sham: Both paths receive excluded deterministic warmup forwards before measurement.
controls.order: Condition order is fixed and counterbalanced across checkpoints in this manifest.
controls.integrity: Abort on manifest, adapter tree, model revision, or upstream dataset revision mismatch.

failure_policy: Harness, dependency, or model-load failures are blocked results. Compatibility-only repairs may be committed and the full affected checkpoint rerun; no decisions may depend on observed accuracy.
training_policy: Neither these benchmark examples nor failures may be used for adapter training, refinement, selection, or retries.
scope_limitations: Four checkpoints selected from an exploratory screen.
GSM8K generation is paired by item but may expose implementation-specific exact-match behavior.
This replication does not include random or norm-matched LoRA controls; those are contingent mechanistic follow-ups.
